_what: Retrieved evidence for the RNase-H1 gap-length and hybrid-length statements the ASO submission manuscript makes in its Methods, and for the MIN_DUPLEX_BP threshold in aso_parent_gap_pairing.py.
_why: Those statements were UNCITED, and one of them was contradicted by a paper this repository already holds. The anchors existed only as open-access full texts on the `literature-cache` branch, where lint_citations.py cannot see them: gate 4 anchors a prose identifier only against files tracked on the working branch. Citing them without this file would fail that gate, and porting the quotes here is also CLAUDE.md section 7 — an artifact the paper depends on that lives only on a cache branch is branch drift.
_what_this_is_not: Not a fetch performed here. Every quote below is copied from a full text ALREADY COMMITTED on the literature-cache branch at the revision named in `source`, and each was re-read from that branch and matched verbatim before this file was written. No identifier and no sentence was written from recollection.

Not a claim that these papers measured the quantity the manuscript uses. The 7-to-10 hybridised-nucleotide figure appears in a discussion paragraph citing prior work, not in a measurement, and nothing here measures it for a 5-6-5 LNA gapmer.
Not exhaustive. These are the records that bear on gap length and hybrid length; the corpus they come from holds 646.
_cost: $0 — read from a branch already in this repository, no network.
